title: Titanium Ultrasonic Booster 35kHz
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Titanium Ultrasonic Booster 35kHz (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic mechanical properties are mandatory for withstanding multi-axial stress states. The 3D forging process eliminates crystallographic texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile strength and >15% elongation in all three orientations. This is critical for 35kHz high-gain step booster amplitude modifier where fatigue crack initiation is sensitive to microstructural anisotropy. This rationale is driven by 35khz high-gain step booster amplitude modifier and specific design requirements.

faq.q: What weight-to-strength ratio does Titanium Ultrasonic Booster 35kHz offer over steel?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130/4340 steel at equivalent strength: 4.43 g/cm³ vs 7.85 g/cm³ with 830 MPa yield. For 35khz highgain step, this translates directly to reduced unsprung mass (suspension) or reduced reciprocating mass (valvetrain), improving both acceleration response and fatigue-limited component life by 2-3×.
